answer_1.quote: We propose here the Multiple TimeLine Summarization (MTLS) task that enhances and further generalizes TLS. MTLS automatically generates a set of timelines that summarize disparate yet important stories... We further propose a Two-Stage Affinity Propagation Summarization framework (2SAPS)...
answer_1.outputs: multiple timelines consisting of date-summary pairs

answer_2.quote: Concatenation-based ROUGE (concat). It considers only the textual overlap... Date-agreement ROUGE (agreement). It measures both textual and temporal information overlap...
